data.title: Scaling Figures and Analyzing Similarity
data.description: Practice applying scale factors about the origin to create dilated figures and explore the relationship between size, shape, and similarity on the coordinate plane.

challenges.narration: A photo is enlarged on screen.
challenges.instruction: Dilate the figure by a scale factor of 3 about the origin. Drag each pink corner to its image.
challenges.hint: Multiply every coordinate by 3: (x, y) → (3x, 3y). The shape stays the same; only its size changes.
challenges.transformLabel: Dilation about the origin by scale factor 3

challenges.narration: A shape zoomed by the projector.

challenges.transformLabel: Dilation about the origin by scale factor 2
